insurer: The insurer refused to pay for the damage because the policy had expired last month.
保险公司拒绝赔偿损失，因为保单上个月已经到期。
severity: Doctors were surprised by the severity of his illness after such a mild start.
病情起初轻微，后来其严重程度让医生们感到吃惊。
inanimate: Young children often treat their toys as if the inanimate objects could feel pain.
小孩子常常把玩具当作有感觉的东西，仿佛这些无生命的物体也会疼痛。
authorities: The local authorities have decided to build a new bridge across the river.
当地当局决定在河上修建一座新桥。
ideologically: The two parties are ideologically opposed, so cooperation is rarely easy.
两党在意识形态上是对立的，因此合作向来不易。
trade-off: Choosing a cheap apartment far from work is a trade-off between money and time.
选择离工作地点很远的便宜公寓，是在金钱和时间之间做权衡。
duplication: The two departments are doing the same work, which leads to unnecessary duplication.
两个部门在做同样的工作，导致不必要的重复。
abandonment: The abandonment of the old factory left a large empty area in the city center.
旧工厂被废弃后，市中心留下一大片空地。
outperform: Students who review daily often outperform those who study only before exams.
每天复习的学生往往胜过只在考前突击的学生。
elaborately: The palace was elaborately decorated with gold and painted scenes from old stories.
宫殿装饰得极为精美，到处是金色和取材于古老故事的彩绘。
enviable: She has an enviable job that allows her to travel around the world every year.
她有一份令人羡慕的工作，每年都能环游世界。
contestant: Each contestant must answer three questions correctly to enter the final round.
每位参赛者必须答对三道题才能进入决赛。
chronically: He is chronically late for meetings, which annoys everyone in the office.
他开会总是习惯性迟到，这让办公室里的每个人都很恼火。
compelling: The lawyer presented compelling evidence that changed the jury's opinion.
律师出示了令人信服的证据，改变了陪审团的看法。
immensely: The new park is immensely popular with families on warm weekends.
每逢温暖的周末，这个新公园都深受家庭游客的极大欢迎。
drummer: The drummer kept the beat while the singer moved across the stage.
鼓手保持着节拍，歌手在舞台上走动。
confrontational: His confrontational style makes it hard for the team to discuss problems calmly.
他好斗的风格让团队很难心平气和地讨论问题。
unified: The country finally formed a unified government after years of division.
经过多年分裂，这个国家终于组建了统一的政府。
justified: Her worry was justified because the train was indeed two hours late.
她的担心是正当的，因为火车确实晚点了两个小时。
indiscriminately: The machine sprayed water indiscriminately, wetting both the plants and the passers-by.
机器不分对象地喷水，把植物和路人都淋湿了。
incompetence: The project failed largely because of the manager's incompetence.
项目失败的主要原因在于经理的无能。
quicken: Your heart rate will quicken as you climb the steep hill.
爬上陡坡时，你的心率会加快。
incalculable: The storm caused incalculable damage to the small fishing villages.
风暴给小渔村造成了不可估量的损失。
scaffolding: Workers climbed the scaffolding to repair the top of the old tower.
工人们爬上脚手架去修理古塔的顶部。
malicious: Someone spread malicious rumors about her at school last term.
上学期有人在学校散布关于她的恶意谣言。
outsource: Many companies outsource their cleaning and repair work to save money.
许多公司把清洁和维修工作外包出去以节省开支。
appreciative: The audience was appreciative and thanked the band with loud applause.
观众深表赞赏，用热烈的掌声感谢乐队。
materialize: Our plans for a summer trip never materialized because of the sudden rain season.
由于雨季突然来临，我们夏天旅行的计划始终没有实现。
cropland: The river's rich soil makes the surrounding cropland extremely productive.
河流肥沃的土壤使周围的农田产量极高。
relieved: She felt relieved when she finally found her lost keys in her coat pocket.
在外套口袋里找到丢失的钥匙后，她感到如释重负。
accrue: Interest will accrue on your savings if you leave the money in the bank.
如果你把钱留在银行里，存款就会积累利息。
mismanagement: Years of mismanagement left the school with neither books nor good teachers.
多年的管理不当使这所学校既没有图书，也没有好老师。
disconnect: Please disconnect the power before you repair the washing machine.
修理洗衣机之前，请先断开电源。
unqualified: An unqualified driver should never be allowed to drive a school bus.
绝不能让不合格的司机驾驶校车。
breezy: The book is written in a breezy style that makes physics seem easy and fun.
这本书风格轻松愉快，让物理学显得简单而有趣。
certification: You need a teaching certification before you can work in a public school.
你需要先取得教师资格证书才能在公立学校工作。
calibration: Regular calibration of the scales ensures that every measurement is accurate.
对天平进行定期校准能确保每次测量都准确。
footpath: Follow the narrow footpath through the woods and you will reach the lake.
沿着穿过树林的狭窄小路走，你就会到达湖边。
southwards: These birds fly southwards every autumn to spend the winter in warmer places.
这些鸟每年秋天向南飞，去更温暖的地方过冬。
uniformly: The walls were painted uniformly, so no corner looks brighter than another.
墙壁粉刷得非常均匀，没有任何一个角落显得比别处更亮。
